label: Galaxies
description: The Milky Way and the four major Local Group galaxies near it, shown while Galaxies is on in Preferences. Their visuals are drawn from published structure, generated on first need.

sources.name: GRAVITY Collaboration (2019); geometric distance to Sagittarius A*
Pietrzyński et al. (2019); eclipsing-binary distance to the Large Magellanic Cloud
Graczyk et al. (2020); eclipsing-binary distance to the Small Magellanic Cloud
Li et al. (2021); HST Cepheid distance to M31
Breuval et al. (2023); HST Cepheid distance to M33
Reid et al. (2019); spiral-arm fits of the Milky Way
NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database; centers and heliocentric velocities

cutoffPolicy: The Milky Way, both Magellanic Clouds, the Andromeda Galaxy and the Triangulum Galaxy: the Local Group galaxies visible to the naked eye.
